title: GetDataShareResponse
description: Response of the Get Data Share operation.

dataShareId.description: The unique identifier of the Data Share.

dataShareName.description: The name of the Data Share.

isShared.description: Indicates whether the Data Share is in Shared state or not.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the Data Share was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time  when the Data Share was last updated.

createdBy.description: The CDP user who created the Data Share.

keywords.description: List of keywords associated with the Data Share.

tags.description: List of the Atlas tags associated with the Data Share.

expiryTime.description: The date and time when the Data Share will expire.

assets.description: List of assets included in the Data Share.

externalUsers.description: List of external users granted access to the Data Share.

summary.description: A brief summary of the Data Share.

termsOfUse.description: The terms of use for the Data Share.

AssetResponse.description: Details of an asset to be included in the Data Share.

resourceId.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

guid.description: The unique identifier of the asset (asset guid from the Atlas).

createTime.description: The date and time when the asset was created.

createdBy.description: The user who created the asset.

updateTime.description: The date and time when the asset was last updated.

updatedBy.description: The user who last updated the asset.

databaseName.description: The name of the database containing the asset.

tableName.description: The name of the table containing the asset.

columns.description: List of columns in the asset (default all is included).

DataShareExternalUser.description: Details of an external user with access to a Data Share.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the external user.

username.description: The username of the external user.

clientId.description: The Client ID of the external user that will be used for authentication.

companyName.description: The company name of the external user.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted to the external user for the Data Share.

sharedOn.description: The date and time when the Data Share was shared with the external user.

validTill.description: The date and time when the access of Data Share will expire for the external user.
